title: Welsh v. Wisconsin (1984)
key_points: Holding: The gravity of the offense matters to exigency; a warrantless night entry to arrest for a minor, non-jailable traffic offense was unreasonable.
officer_notes: Scenario: You go into a home to arrest a driver for a minor violation before alcohol in his blood dissipates.
Takeaway: Minor offenses rarely justify warrantless home entry.
